title: Tang Chung Ling Ancestral Hall
geometryBasis: Named Lands Department survey polygons and Hong Kong Principal Datum building heights, the unchanged 5-metre government terrain raster, and the original Qualla public-domain facade photograph.
sectionBasis: The entrance hall faces the mapped open forecourt. The central axis continues through three roofed halls separated by the two open courts recorded by the Antiquities and Monuments Office. A gray tile roof with upswept tips and an ornamented ridge runs across the entrance.
limitations: Scope covers the three principal halls, surrounding walls and two internal courtyards. Exterior ancillary buildings outside the named survey polygons are separate.
The exact positions of the courtyard partitions, rear openings and individual ridge ornaments are visually estimated.
